action.en: Once the skills menu is available, check this bar before choosing how to approach the next encounter. A missing trophy does not reveal its progress. In New Game+, prioritize the skills still missing.

approach.pt: Para desenvolver prudência, atravesse os encontros evitando eliminar inimigos. Confira a barra após o encontro antes de repetir a abordagem.
approach.en: To develop Prudence, pass encounters while avoiding enemy kills. Check the bar afterward before repeating the approach.

recovery.pt: Antes de avançar muito na segunda campanha, confira as barras restantes. Voltar por seleção de capítulo restaura o estado daquele ponto e pode exigir rejogar os trechos seguintes.
recovery.en: Before advancing far into the second campaign, check remaining skill bars. Chapter select restores the state at that point and may require replaying subsequent sections.
